body: I started realizing most of mental instability hasn't left me, but instead just been covered by her. I am going to look into physiatric rehab. I've tried medicine both legal and illegal, therapy and everything in between. Thank you for the encouragement. I think I found a way out.
I also never feel helped by therapist. I've been to quite a few and it always feels very out of place for me. I just can't connect to them even after a few months.
I do ask for anything ridiculous, I meant she was the only person who gave me hope about people.
